name: Mayfair
intro: London's grandest dining rooms, hotel bars and members' clubs, between Hyde Park and Regent Street.

name: Soho
intro: Late nights, small rooms and the best people-watching in town.

name: Marylebone
intro: A village in the middle of the city, with neighbourhood restaurants and quiet townhouse hotels.

name: St James's
intro: Old London at its smartest, from the theatres of Haymarket to the clubs of Pall Mall.

name: Victoria
intro: Hotel dining rooms and new openings a short walk from the palace.

name: Holborn
intro: Between the West End and the City, with old-school dining rooms worth the detour.
